description: Hand-written two-cycle lifecycle fixtures. NOT produced by data/synthetic/generator.py — a generator that writes both the defect and its remedy would make the closure metric circular, proving code execution rather than matching quality.

setl_lc_exact.reason: exact amount, explicit reference, unique match

setl_lc_wrong_amount.reason: adjustment credits 3500 against a 4000 delta — no tolerance

setl_lc_duplicate_adjustments.reason: two identical valid adjustments; one-to-one fails, so nothing binds

setl_lc_no_reference.reason: exact amount but the adjustment names no settlement
